theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (ξ : Rn n) (R r : ℝ) (u φ : Rn n → ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < R → U ⊆ closedBall ξ R → Integrable u volume → (∃ K, LipschitzWith K φ) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → (∀ᵐ x ∂volume, r * ‖fderiv ℝ φ x‖ ≤ -fderiv ℝ φ x (x - ξ)) → ENNReal.ofReal r * ∫⁻ x, ‖u x‖ₑ * ‖fderiv ℝ φ x‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R * Chapter02.bvVariationOn (fun x ↦ |u x|) U + (n : ℝ≥0∞) * ∫⁻ x in U, ‖u x‖ₑ
